targetTexts.1: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
targetTexts.2: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
targetTexts.3: In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.
targetTexts.4: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
targetTexts.5: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
targetTexts.6: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
targetTexts.7: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach—not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.
targetTexts.8: Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.
targetTexts.9: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.
targetTexts.10: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,
targetTexts.11: who must be silenced. For the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households and teach things they should not.
targetTexts.12: As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
targetTexts.13: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith
targetTexts.14: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
targetTexts.15: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
targetTexts.16: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
